verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly list 'Two Factor Authentication' and OTP support (login using OTP for Google/Facebook), and the Nitrokey 3 product page mentions 'one-time passwords' among combined features, indicating TOTP/HOTP slot support. However, no explicit mention of HOTP challenge-response mode, no detail on number of slots, no independent hands-on verification of OTP functionality, and community evidence focuses on other features (HSM, durability) without confirming OTP reliability. Missing for 10: explicit challenge-response documentation, slot-count/configuration details, independent hands-on confirmation of OTP/HOTP working as advertised.
